newsitem.title: FINLAND: M-SERLA SEES BETTER END-YR PROFIT LEVEL.
newsitem.headline: M-SERLA SEES BETTER END-YR PROFIT LEVEL.

text.p: Finnish forestry group Metsa-Serla Oy said on Thursday it expected profits to be better at the end of 1997 than they were at the start of the year.
"The earnings level for the end of the year is still expected to remain good and to be better than in the early part of the year," the company said in a statement with its H1 report.

"Pinewood pulp and short-fibre pulp prices are expected to rise from the end-year," it said, adding this would require control of producer stocks and possibly sustained output halts during the autumn.
